# Drifted Marketing

A growth agency — ads, content and AI apps. A small Gen-Z team, led by a Gen-Z founder, working out of Karachi for brands in the United States and beyond. Three disciplines under one monthly fee: performance media, creator growth, and custom AI product. No account layer between the client and the people doing the work.

- Contact: operations@driftedmarketing.com · (346) 716-2948
- Based: Karachi, Pakistan. Founded 2026.
- Site: https://driftedmarketing.com

## What we do

- [Services](https://driftedmarketing.com/services): performance media (Meta and Google), creator growth and content, and AI product built for the brand rather than bought off a shelf. Sold together, under one fee.
- [How we work](https://driftedmarketing.com/about): founder-led. The person in the pitch is the person doing the work. One number and one date go in the contract.
- [Start a project](https://driftedmarketing.com/contact)

## Questions we get asked

### What does it actually cost?

One monthly fee that covers performance, creative, build and counsel. We price it to your revenue target on the first call — out loud, with a number, before any contract exists. If the maths does not work for you, we will say so and point you somewhere cheaper.

### How fast until we see anything?

Work in week one. Numbers by week four. We publish the check-in cadence in the contract, and a month with nothing to point at is treated as a failure — ours, not yours.

### How do we know it is working?

Every figure we report names its client and carries a receipt. The Gallery gets $5.20–$6 back per $1 of ads, every campaign. That is published, not claimed — and where a number is not measured yet, the page says pending rather than guessing.

### Is the AI work snake oil?

Sometimes, elsewhere. Here it is a typist with perfect stamina: 1,250 auction listings written from photographs, 400+ hours returned to a real team, every listing checked by a person. The machine does volume; people do judgement.

### What if we want out?

Thirty days’ notice. You keep everything we made — files, accounts, ad history, the lot. If the work does not hold you, a clause should not have to.

### Are we too small for you?

The Poster Project started from an 811-follower base and reached 2.2M views in ninety days, 80% of it organic. The Gallery is a family business. Small means the founder is in the room and decisions happen the same day — we actively prefer it.

### Who actually does the work?

The people in the studio photograph. There is no account layer and no handoff to someone junior at signature. When you call, a person who touched your work answers — that is structural, not a promise.

### Why “Drifted”?

Because we drifted from how agencies are supposed to run — the theatre, the bloat, the invented metrics — and kept only the craft. The name is the pitch; the site is the evidence.

## Things we will not say

- No invented client, number, testimonial or case study. A figure that has not been measured is marked pending, in capitals, on the page.
- No manufactured scarcity. No countdown, no closing seats.
- No unexpanded acronyms. We write “every $1 of ads brought back $5.20–$6”, not a three-letter abbreviation.
